subject: Engage checklist: decision criteria, owners, and weekly bump
messages:
From: sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
To: alex.jenkins@tritonedata.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0400
Subject: Engage checklist: decision criteria, owners, and weekly bump

Alex — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed playbook so we keep the trial moving without surprises. High level goal: prove 30% reduction in average intent-classification latency and <1% precision regression vs your current baseline across the test corpus within a 4-week window.

Attached: trial-eval-matrix.xlsx (baseline metrics, success thresholds, sample prompts) and SOC2-questionnaire.pdf (you asked for our security summary).

Immediate next steps (owners & timelines):
- Data handoff (Triton): 3 representative batches (small/medium/large) by Wed 2026-10-13 — owner: Alex
- Synthetic sampling + anonymization checklist (Triton) — include PII filter results with dataset — owner: Partnerships team
- Infra & access (Redwood): S3 ingestion pipeline + read-only credentials by Fri 2026-10-15 — owner: Marissa Cole
- Run 1: baseline vs Redwood v1.2 quantized model — run window 10/16–10/18 — owner: Lauren Bishop
- Eval rubric: latency percentiles (p50/p90/p99), token cost delta, precision/recall on intent labels, failure-case sampling — see tab 'Acceptance' in attached matrix

Please confirm these owners/timelines or propose adjustments. If we align, I’ll send a one-page mutual action plan we can both sign off on and schedule the enablement call (30 min) to kick off ingestion and credentialing.

Thanks — short one: confirm datasets & who owns anonymization by Wed so we can hit the 4-week window.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0189
Redwood Inference

Attachments: trial-eval-matrix.xlsx (xlsx), SOC2-questionnaire.pdf (pdf)

From: alex.jenkins@tritonedata.com
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: partnerships@tritonedata.com, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2026 17:24:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Engage checklist: decision criteria, owners, and weekly bump

Sean — appreciate the concise plan. Quick responses inline:
- Owners/timelines: OK to us. I (Alex) will own the dataset deliveries. Expect first batch Monday 10/12 (small), then medium on 10/14, large on 10/18.
- Anonymization: Partnerships will run PII filter; I will attach the filter log with the medium batch.
- Acceptance criteria: the latency targets look reasonable, but can we add a secondary quality gate — 'no more than 2% drop in top-3 intent coverage' for high-volume intents?

Two asks from Triton side:
1) Minimal schema for ingestion (S3 prefix layout, manifest format) — we need a sample pipeline spec to hand to our infra team.
2) List of columns/fields Redwood needs for downstream eval (e.g., original_text, label, sample_id, timestamp).

If you can send the mutual action plan and pipeline spec by EOD Monday, we'll slot the enablement call for Tue 10/13 11:00am PT.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Jenkins
Head of Integrations, Triton Analytics
alex.jenkins@tritonedata.com

On Sat, Oct 10, 2026 at 3:02 PM sean.gallagher@redwood.ai wrote:
> Alex — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed playbook...

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: alex.jenkins@tritonedata.com
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 09:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Engage checklist: decision criteria, owners, and weekly bump

Looping in our infra and eval owners — Lauren, I'm marking you for Run 1 (10/16–10/18) and for the acceptance scripts. Sean, I can provision the S3 bucket and a read-only IAM role; will post credentials to the shared vault (link below) once Alex confirms the prefix layout.

Action items for Redwood:
- Marissa: create S3 bucket + manifest template by Mon 10/12 EOD; coordinate credentials with Alex
- Lauren: prepare eval harness and p50/p90/p99 latency measurement script; create a quick runbook for the medium batch by 10/15
- Sean: finalize mutual action plan and send to Alex; I'll attach the manifest template to that doc

I'll schedule an internal pre-call with infra + eval on Mon 10/12 10:00am PT to validate the manifest and ingestion flow.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Related links: https://docs.redwood.com/shared/drive/trial-runsheet-DL-87321

From: sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
To: alex.jenkins@tritonedata.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Engage checklist: decision criteria, owners, and weekly bump

Quick weekly nudge — thanks for the fast replies and for confirming owners. Two quick reminders so the trial stays on schedule:
- Alex: we still need the small batch by EOD today (10/12) to validate the ingestion path. If you hit any blocking permission issues, loop Marissa immediately at marissa.cole@redwood.ai.
- Partnerships: please include the anonymization/PII filter report with the medium batch so Lauren can validate quality gates before Run 1.
- Redwood: Marissa to upload manifest template and Lauren to share the runbook by 10/15.

If any of the items above slip past 10/15 we will need to shift the Run 1 window and update the mutual action plan. Otherwise I’ll send the mutual action plan + calendar invite for Tue 10/13 11:00am PT this afternoon.

Thanks all — short call tomorrow to kick things off.

—Sean
